description.value: VirtualServiceDetail Type: The set of values required to describe a virtual service's connection details, including some limitations of the service.

definition.value: The set of values required to describe a virtual service's connection details, including some limitations of the service.
The type of virtual service to connect to (i.e. Teams, Zoom, Specific VMR technology, WhatsApp).

comment.value:
As this type defines what the virtual service is, it then defines what address and additional information might be relevant.
Some profiles could be used for specific types to define what the other values could/should be.

valueMarkdown.value: The purpose for which an extended contact detail should be used.

description.value: The purpose for which an extended contact detail should be used.

definition.value: What address or number needs to be used for a user to connect to the virtual service to join. The channelType informs as to which datatype is appropriate to use (requires knowledge of the specific type).

short.value: Web address to see alternative connection details

definition.value: A web address that provides additional details on the call, such as alternative/regional call in numbers, or other associated services.

short.value: Maximum number of participants supported by the virtual service

definition.value: Maximum number of participants supported by the virtual service where there are limitations imposed.

comment.value:
Some services have only a limitted number of participants permitted to connect at a time, this is typically used in "shared" virtual services that you might find on location resources.
Typically on-demand services might not have these restrictions.

short.value: Session Key required by the virtual service

definition.value: Some systems require an additional factor/value be provided to access the service.

comment.value:
Some services require a session key to be able to access the service once connected.
This could be in cases where a shared number is used, and a session key is added to put into a private line, or to identify the participant in a call.
